_comment: First-party git dependencies built into the wheelhouse. pip's VCS syntax accepts ONE ref, so pyproject.toml pins the TAG and this file pins the tag object AND the peeled commit; packaging/tools/build_git_wheels.py clones the tag, fails unless HEAD == commit, and builds from the clean clone. runtime-contracts is a benchmarked component: its pin (v0.3.4) is not to be changed here.

dependencies.name: runtime-contracts
dependencies.note: The tag commits a stale build/lib tree (15 files of older code). It must be removed from the clean clone before building, and the wheel is compared against the git tree afterwards.

dependencies.name: knowledge-frontier
dependencies.note: Pinned by commit d6a78ca3 (v0.1.0) as built by the frozen run. Agent `licences` may exclude it from the shipped set; this pin is not a decision to ship it.

dependencies.name: redevops-connectors
dependencies.note: Replaces the floating @main of the frozen build. v0.1.0 is the exact commit the frozen CI run cloned; main has since moved (15 commits as of 2026-11-04).
